rule: Layouts for types Ghidra has only as empty one-byte placeholders, or not at all. ApplyFacts applyStructs lays each out in place (or makes it). _LocaleUpdate, _Lockit and DName are the Visual Studio 2010 CRT's own (the client is linked with it): _LocaleUpdate from crt/src/setlocal.h, _Lockit from yvals.h, DName from undname.cxx. The others are read off the client's code; each says where

MD5Context.evidence: MD5Init/MD5Update/MD5Final (0x408da0, 0x40b1f0, 0x40b2a0): state @0, bit count @0x10 (low, high), the 64-byte block buffer @0x18; ReadEncryptionReply keeps one in a 92-byte local

Blowfish.evidence: BlowfishInit (0x409a70): P[18] @0, S[4][256] @0x48; ReadEncryptionReply allocates 0x1048 bytes for it

LobbyCryptEngine.evidence: its constructor (0xe377b0) and WriteEncryptionInit/ReadEncryptionReply (0xe36880, 0xe38140): +4..+0x30 is the 0x2c-byte block MD5 makes the Blowfish key from; ServiceConsumerConnectionManager embeds it at +0x88..+0xbc
